6.64 rsInvalidDataElementNameNotCLSCompliant
rsInvalidDataElementNameNotCLSCompliant is a critical error that will occur when any element with a
DataElementName child element (such as Tablix.DataElementName) contains a value that is not
CLS-compliant [UTR15].
